messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — ACME Analytics showing clear expansion signals. Two new teams (Data Science + Product) have started onboarding this week, they're hitting ~3x previous request rate during peak, and renewal is 60 days out. Need an enablement and capacity plan. Key asks from them: embeddings for semantic search, multi-tenant rate limits, and lower latency for short-chat flows. @Marco Chen can you pull the recent qps/latency per model? :eyes:

onboard-bot: Priya Rao (pri...@acme.com) joined the workspace and completed step 2 of onboarding checklist (API keys created).

Marco Chen: Pulled metrics — 90min window shows avg QPS 18 -> peak 55 yesterday, 95th latency on gpt-open-6B is 320ms but token tail spikes to 900ms when sequence length >1024. They're sending a lot of short prompts which would benefit from smaller context models or prefix caching. I'm recommending: 1) enable prefix cache for chat routes 2) add model variant rdx-quant-v2 for short chats 3) increase burst capacity to +2 vGPU for next 2 weeks.

Diego Alvarez: I'll coordinate a brief enablement session for Product next Wed. Can we get a sequence of demo prompts and evals? They asked for embedding-based search — is there any example dataset we can use?

Aisha Patel: @Priya Rao could you drop 3 example queries and one sample doc set? Also, they noted compliance question re: dedicated data isolation for Product team. That might impact Dedicated vs Hosted decision.

Priya Rao: Quick replies — sending sample queries now. The Product team wants sub-200ms for chatbot snippets; Data Science can tolerate 350-400ms. They're okay with Dedicated if it reduces cost volatility. Also asked whether caching is compatible with PII redaction.

Marco Chen: PII redaction is fine, but we should avoid caching raw user inputs — instead cache model prefixes and responses after redaction. I'll draft config snippet:

```
route: /chat
cache:
  prefix: true
  redact: true
  ttl: 3600
model_variant: rdx-quant-v2
autoscale:
  burst_add: 2
  min_vgpu: 1
```

Aisha Patel: Next steps — (1) Marco to prod the config and estimate cost delta (due EOD tomorrow). (2) Diego to run enablement and collect feedback. (3) I will flag renewal team and prepare contract options (dedicated vs hosted) and include extra seat pricing for Product team. Also tagging @account-exec for upsell motion. :rocket:

Marco Chen: Cost estimate done, extra burst +2 vGPU roughly +18% spend at current load, switching to rdx-quant-v2 saves ~22% per-token. Net expected delta +(-) ~ -5% overall, will add detailed numbers to the doc.

Aisha Patel: Great — please add docs link and I'll schedule renewal conversation. Priya, thanks — let's sync after the enablement session.

Priya Rao: Thanks all — looking forward to the session.

Diego Alvarez: Added calendar invite for Wed 11am PT.

Aisha Patel: Filing feedback: product likes embedding similarity and cheap quantized versions. Renewal risk lowered if we commit to predictable throughput and a brief pilot of Dedicated. Marking as 'At-risk -> warming' in CRM. :white_check_mark:
